defect: The temporal ledger accepted checkpoint IDs absent from the admitted graph and allowed a settled finite-graph checkpoint to be settled again with replacement evidence.
repair: Require an admitted checkpoint node and no prior settlement of that checkpoint before appending a checkpoint fact. Rejections leave the event chain unchanged.
integration_constraint: Compiler-inserted native postcondition checkpoints are not automatically source-plan checkpoints. The future bridge must map them explicitly and must not invent admitted source checkpoint IDs.
